description:
Adds an other name. In QuickBooks, the “other names” list contains any names that don’t appear on customer, vendor, or employee lists.

The `other_name_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3100 name_in_use, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account

account_number.description: Account numbers appear in the QuickBooks chart of accounts, Account fields, and reports and graphs.

alt_contact.description: The name of an alternate contact person for a vendor, customer, or “other name” entry.

alt_phone.description: A telephone number given as an alternative to Phone.

company_name.description: The name of the QuickBooks user’s business, as specified in QuickBooks. `company_name` and Address are used on invoices, checks, and other forms.

contact.description: The name of a contact person for a customer or vendor.

external_guid.description: Allows for the attachment of a user defined GUID value.

first_name.description: The first name of a customer, vendor, employee, or person on the “other names” list.

include_qbxml.description: Also return the qbXML this compiles to, for debugging. Not part of the v2 request.

is_active.description: If `is_active` is true, this object is currently enabled for use by QuickBooks. The default value is true.

last_name.description: The last name of a customer, vendor, employee, or person on the “other names” list.

middle_name.description: The middle name of a customer, vendor, employee, or person on the “other names” list.

name.description: Name is the case-insensitive short name of a list object (without ancestors). It must be unique within its hierarchy scope.

other_name_address.description: If an address request fails, some combination of address fields might be too long.

addr1.description: The first line of an address.

addr2.description: The second line of an address (if a second line is needed).

addr3.description: The third line of an address (if a third line is needed).

addr4.description: The fourth line of an address (if a fourth line is needed).

addr5.description: The fifth line of an address (if a fifth line is needed).

city.description: The city name in an address.

country.description: The country name in an address, or, in returned Host information (HostRet or HostInfo), the country for which this edition of QuickBooks was designed. (Possible values are US, CA, UK, and AU.)

note.description: In a BillAddress or ShipAddress aggregate, the Note field value is written at the bottom of the address in the form in which it appears, such as the invoice form.

postal_code.description: The postal code in an address.

state.description: The state name in an address.

request_id.description: Your own label for the request, sent to QuickBooks as its qbXML `requestID` and echoed in the raw answer (`response_xml`); optional, since the answer's webhook already carries the request's `id`.

salutation.description: A formal reference, such as Mr. or Dr., that precedes a name.

qbxml.description: The qbXML it compiles to. Only with include_qbxml.
